# Gustavo Sanchez

> Gustavo Sanchez is a full-stack AI engineer in San Francisco who combines production software delivery, systems thinking, and 17 years of enterprise software GTM leadership.

This is Gustavo's official portfolio. He is an electronic and telecommunications engineer from Colombia who builds practical AI products with modern TypeScript and Python stacks. He is authorized to work in the United States and does not require sponsorship.

## Portfolio

- [Signal](https://www.gustavosanchez.dev/#intro): Role positioning, delivery evidence, location, and availability.
- [Case studies](https://www.gustavosanchez.dev/#work): EnglishChunks.guru, Nelson, and FX Checker with constraints, system decisions, outcomes, and measured proof. All three were built with spec-driven development (SDD); EnglishChunks.guru also ships AI features.
- [How Gustavo works](https://www.gustavosanchez.dev/#process): A four-stage workflow from problem framing through production verification.
- [Experience](https://www.gustavosanchez.dev/#experience): Software engineering, enterprise GTM leadership, telecommunications engineering, education, and certifications.
- [Social](https://www.gustavosanchez.dev/#social): Verified profiles on LinkedIn, X, Master.dev, Bluesky, GitHub, Frontend Mentor, and DEV.
- [Contact](https://www.gustavosanchez.dev/#contact): Professional inquiries and availability.

## Selected projects

- [EnglishChunks.guru](https://englishchunks.guru): A privacy-conscious daily English speaking coach with open-model pronunciation scoring, AI feedback, progress tracking, subscriptions, and an administration workflow. Spec-driven; AI features.
- [IdiomsMasterGirl](https://github.com/gusanchefullstack/idioms-master-girl): A local-first English idiom coach using Gemma and faster-whisper. Spec-driven; AI features.
- [Nelson Personal Budget App](https://fsdev-nelson-frontend.vercel.app): A full-stack budgeting product with forecasting, reporting, authentication, and accessible responsive interfaces. Spec-driven.
- [FX Checker](https://fsdev-foreign-exchange-checker.vercel.app): A tested currency intelligence interface with live rates, history, comparison, export, and offline fallback (121 automated tests, 100 Lighthouse accessibility). Spec-driven.
